$comment: EDIT ME — single source of truth for the 5-stage Manila MSME compliance roadmap. Each stage: id, index, title, agency, agencyUrl, summary, subSteps[], uploadLabel, chips[], outputs[] (the document that completes the stage), filing (online / in person).

stages.title: National Business Name Registration (DTI)
stages.summary: Secure your national business name so every downstream Manila clearance can reference it.

subSteps.label: Business Name Search & Territorial Scope Selection
Download Certificate of Business Name Registration (CBNR)

stages.uploadLabel: DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration
chips: What are DTI's business name rules?
Which territorial scope should I pick?
Can I register my business name online?
outputs: DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration

filing.note: Register online in about 30 minutes, or at a DTI office or Negosyo Center.

stages.title: Barangay Business Clearance
stages.summary: Your barangay endorses the business location before the City of Manila will assess it.

subSteps.label: Notarized Lease Contract + RPT Receipt
subSteps.detail: Real Property Tax receipt of the lessor

chips: What do I need for a barangay clearance?
What if my business is home-based?
How much is a barangay clearance?

filing.note: Apply at the barangay hall that covers your business address.

stages.title: Special Local Clearances (Manila Line Bureaus)
stages.agency: CPDO (Zoning) / Manila Health Dept / BFP Manila
stages.summary: Food service triggers three parallel line-bureau clearances before the Mayor's Permit assessment.

subSteps.label: Zoning / Locational Clearance
subSteps.detail: City Planning & Development Office — checks Manila zoning ordinance for your district

subSteps.label: Sanitary Permit & Yellow Health Cards
subSteps.detail: MHD — staff Chest X-Ray, Stool & Urine exams required

subSteps.label: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC)
subSteps.detail: BFP — dry chemical fire extinguisher on site required

stages.uploadLabel: Zoning Clearance and Sanitary Permit and Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC)
chips: How do my staff get health cards?
Is my location zoned for my business?

filing.note: Ask the Bureau of Permits at Manila City Hall where each clearance is processed.

stages.title: GO! Manila Mayor's Business Permit
stages.summary: Consolidated online assessment and payment of your Local Business Tax and regulatory fees.

subSteps.label: Upload Clearances & Generate Statement of Account (SOA)
Pay Local Business Tax (LBT) & Regulatory Fees online

chips: Can I apply for my mayor's permit online?
How is Manila's business tax computed?
Where do I claim my business plate?

filing.note: Apply through GO! Manila, or at the Bureau of Permits in Manila City Hall.

stages.title: BIR Tax Registration & Invoicing
stages.agency: Bureau of Internal Revenue (Assigned Manila RDO)
stages.summary: Final national step: your Certificate of Registration, invoices and books of accounts.

subSteps.label: Secure Authority to Print (Form 1906) for Sales Invoices
subSteps.detail: ARF ₱500 repealed under the EOPT Act

subSteps.label: Stamp 4 Books of Accounts
subSteps.detail: Journal, Ledger, Cash Receipts, Cash Disbursements

subSteps.label: Receive BIR Form 2303 (COR) & "Ask for Receipt" Poster

chips: Do I qualify for the BMBE income tax exemption?
Can I register with the BIR online?

filing.note: Register online through ORUS, or at the Revenue District Office for your address.
